summary: Additive API change: new POST /api/v1/links/batch in LinkController delegating to a new transactional LinkService.createBatch that pre-validates with UrlValidator and reuses create(). New problem-detail mapping for batch validation errors. No schema change.

impactedFiles.why: map BatchValidationException to 400 with per-index errors
batch requests consume one token per request (review rate-limit semantics)

dataFlowChanges: N inserts in one transaction; a failure rolls back the whole batch

regressionRisks.risk: refactoring create() could change existing behaviour
regressionRisks.testFocus: existing LinkApiIntegrationTest must stay green; createBatch reuses create() unchanged

regressionRisks.risk: one request now creates up to 50 links
regressionRisks.testFocus: document; consider weighting tokens by batch size
